title: Risk of heart attack, stroke or death: with vs without microplastics in artery plaque

source.name: Microplastics and Nanoplastics in Atheromas and Cardiovascular Events
source.publisher: New England Journal of Medicine (Marfella et al.)

notes: Patients whose carotid artery plaque contained microplastics/nanoplastics had a 4.5-fold higher rate of the combined outcome of heart attack, stroke, or death over a mean 34-month follow-up, vs patients whose plaque had none. Baseline (no microplastics) set to 1.0x; index value, not a percent.
